messages:
maya: Need a compact 'microbench' asset pack for webinar 3 tiles (latency / cost / quality), 600x200 header, 16:9 slide, SVG icons. Mobile-first. Deadline Tue EOD.
juan: Can do. Unified sparkline or unique charts per tile? Include per-token micro-panel?
maya: Unified sparkline, yes to per-token micro-panel (relative vs baseline, no $). Avoid absolutes per legal.
kevin: I'll spin up the Figma file and add tokens + export presets. Starter link: https://figma.com/file/microbench-176654
legal: Reminder: no "fastest" or "cheapest" claims. Use qualifying language: "latency-optimized" / "cost-efficient". Add methodology footnote and alt text.
l10n: For FR/JA provide source strings CSV with context notes; CTAs <=18 chars.
design-bot: Task created: FIGMA-3001 "microbench-pack". Assigned: @kevin, @juan. Due 2025-06-10. Review slot Wed 11:30am PT.
maya: Thanks team  ping here when first pass is uploaded for a 15-min review. :rocket:
